name: de-apps-root
description: Monorepo root — shared shell in packages/, apps in apps/ (SpyDE still at electron/ + spyde/).

scripts._comment:test:unit: --if-present SKIPS a workspace with no test:unit script, so this reports success when it has run NOTHING — which it did until shell-main's script was named to match. If you rename a package's test script, check the run still reports the expected test count.
